summary: Phase I3-I10 upstream Core foundation. Read parent AGENTS.md, AlembicCore/AGENTS.md, the active state root, the original cold-start Original Plan/Requirement Design, and `Design/docs/current/recipe-coldstart-strict-test-profile-supplement-requirement-design-2026-07-30.md`. Implement only AlembicCore-owned deterministic/public contracts for the explicit `strict-test-dimension` profile. Required behavior: (1) keep existing `strict-production` compiler, exact 26-dimension catalog, all eligible production cells and `deferredCells=[]` byte/semantic behavior unchanged; do not repurpose `src/shared/testMode.ts`; (2) add additive versioned public contracts/exports for strict-test preflight, preview/recommendation, exactly-one selection confirmation, immutable execution projection, private terminal/report and drift/non-mutation bindings; names may adapt to repository conventions but the profile discriminator and semantics must be explicit, never inferred from env/dimension count; (3) build/validate a full preflight view from a fully compiled strict plan plus caller-supplied runtime/project/config/artifact bindings: preserve project/source/facts/catalog/applicability/query/backend/full-cell universe hashes and surface per-dimension applicable/excluded/unknown + eligible/excluded cell counts; unknown/unsupported/empty/duplicate/missing/extra/facts-lineage mismatch fails closed; (4) derive an exactly-one-dimension execution projection only from a validated preflight + hash-bound confirmation; selected cells must equal all eligible cells for that dimension, no module/file subset, no second dimension, no silent removal; unselected dimensions remain explicitly not executed by the test profile and never become production deferred/excluded/completed; default architecture recommendation is allowed only when applicable with non-empty eligible cells and supported facts/backends, otherwise provide evidence-backed alternatives; (5) define canonical hashes and drift invalidation checks for preflight, confirmation and projection, plus private completion semantics `STRICT_TEST_COMPLETED_PRIVATE` / failure; productionFinalized=false and publicRouteChanged=false are invariant fields; (6) reuse existing private serving/final coverage/G4 neutral contracts by reference/type composition where possible, without adding host orchestration, filesystem, HTTP, Dashboard, Agent runtime, Plugin, cleanup/reset or public CAS behavior to Core; (7) add focused positive/negative tests proving exact catalog and full universe remain frozen, one-dimension projection conservation, invalid selections/drift reject, production contracts/tests remain unchanged, exports resolve. Non-goals: no product data reset/write, no Main/Agent/Dashboard/Plugin edits, no briefing-only fallback, no production shortcut, no fixed BiliDili dimension before runtime preflight. Commit all Core changes in AlembicCore. Validation: targeted new tests plus existing `ColdStartProductionPlanCompiler.test.ts`/relevant plan tests; `npm run build:check`; `npm run test`; `npm run lint`; public API/layer/retired-symbol boundary checks as applicable; `git diff --check`; Alembic Guard. Backfill commit hash, changed files, exact commands/output, exported contract surface, compatibility proof, risks and downstream integration notes for AlembicAgent and Alembic.
designIntent: 在不削弱 strict-production 全 26 维与 deferredCells=[] 合同的前提下，新增显式 strict-test-dimension profile 的版本化 receipt、validator 和 full-universe→exactly-one-dimension execution projection，供 Agent/Main/Dashboard 共同消费。
